summary: First-finish smoke test of Dashboard Informasi Kelurahan. Backend GET/auth/CRUD endpoints all functional; frontend dashboard, darurat, kader, admin login flow, theme toggle, and mobile bottom nav all working. No console errors detected.
passed: GET /api/info returns Kelurahan info (name=Kelurahan Sukamaju, KK=2547, penduduk=8934, RT=24, RW=6)
GET /api/contacts?category=emergency returns 11 items; ambulans sample includes status='available' and 'Standby 24 jam'
GET /api/announcements returns 4 items; GET /api/agenda returns 4 items
POST /api/auth/login with admin@kelurahan.id/admin123 returns access_token+user; wrong password returns 401 'Email atau password salah'
GET /api/auth/me without token returns 401; with Bearer token returns admin user
POST /api/contacts unauth returns 401; with Bearer creates entity
DELETE /api/contacts/{id} works with token; non-existent returns 404 'Kontak tidak ditemukan'
Frontend Dashboard loads with stats-grid and announcements-ticker
Emergency page: search filter narrows to 2 cards for 'ambulans'; CSV & PDF download buttons visible
/admin redirects to /admin/login when unauthenticated; login navigates to admin panel with contacts/announcements/agenda tabs
Theme toggle switches html class from 'light' to 'dark'
Mobile viewport (390x844) shows bottom-nav with 5 items
